description: Extract 'People also search for' / similar / related places from any Google Maps business page.

language.description: Language for the Google Maps interface (affects names/categories in some markets).
language.title: Language

maxResults.description: Maximum number of similar places to extract (1-50).
maxResults.title: Max Results

placeId.description: Canonical Google Place ID beginning with ChIJ. Use this instead of placeUrl when available.
placeId.title: Google Place ID

placeUrl.description: Google Maps URL of the business page to extract similar places from.
placeUrl.title: Place URL

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy. Leave default; the scraper works from datacenter IPs without proxy. Used as fallback only.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

title: Google Maps Similar Places Scraper
